rules: Every file under tests/fixtures/ (except broker/ and these lists) is listed here with its sha256, its licence and where it comes from. Only CC0-1.0, public-domain or own-work. A photo needs its page URL and author; own work names the script that makes it; a golden reference names the model id, the pinned revision and the backend it came from. None may match tests/fixtures/denylist-runonweb-samples.sha256.

source.author: Joselodos
source.file: The 960-pixel-wide rendering that Wikimedia Commons serves of the original, with its Exif block (author fields) removed; the image data is untouched.

files.purpose: cutout: a photo with one clear subject (a dog lying on grass) whose background the site removes.

source.how: Traced by hand over foto.jpg before any model ran on it (outline of the dog, and the grass between its front legs as a hole); the spec fills it with the even-odd rule.

files.purpose: cutout: the subject's outline, independent of any model. The site's mask (alpha of 128 or more) must overlap it with an IoU of at least 0.85.

source.how: Run with ELFFUSS_AI_RECORD=cutout: the alpha channel of the PNG the cutout page gave for foto.jpg in configuration B, saved as a grey PNG.

files.checked: Against an independent run of the same ONNX file with ONNX Runtime for the CPU, Pillow's bilinear resize and torch's bilinear upsampling: IoU 0.9994, mean alpha error 0.0002. Against mascara.json: IoU 0.944.
files.purpose: cutout: the reference mask. In both configurations the site's mask must match it with an IoU of at least 0.98 and a mean alpha error of at most 0.01.
